entry.title: PotentialHeat 1.3.0
entry.summary: **PotentialHeat 1.3.0** - **LEVEL MATCH now measures.** It compares how loud the sound is going in and coming out (over about a second) and turns the processed sound down by the difference, so louder never just sounds better. Before, it guessed from DRIVE alone. Projects with LEVEL MATCH on will now sit at the same loudness as the dry sound. - **Drum-bus pair presets**: Boom Bap Bus, Lo-Fi Bus, Modern Bus and Glue Bus. entry.title: PotentialHeat 1.2.0
entry.summary: **PotentialHeat 1.2.0** - **ROLL**: one tap for a random setting that still sounds good: drive, character, tone, ceiling and mix. **MILD**, **MEDIUM** or **WILD** under it sets how far it goes (MILD stays gentle, WILD pushes hard). LEVEL MATCH is kept on and OUTPUT at 0 dB, so a roll never jumps in volume. Keep rolling until you like it, then fine-tune. - The preset keys are a little narrower to make room for it. entry.title: PotentialHeat 1.0.1
entry.summary: - Fixed: pressing **STOP** or **Overdub** while the MPC was playing could reload the preset and undo your DRIVE / TONE / MIX tweaks. The MPC's host briefly changes a plugin's first parameter when it re-prepares audio, and that was PRESET. That first slot now does nothing; PRESET is a new parameter at the end (same menu, same Q-Link). Saved projects open with their preset and settings as before.

entry.title: PotentialHeat 1.0.0
entry.summary: **PotentialHeat 1.0.0**, the first release. A soft clipper and bus saturator for your MPC: warmth, glue and loudness without clipping. Three characters (soft, tape, hard), tone, ceiling, level match and 12 one-tap presets. See the [README](https://github.com/PotentialBreakfast/mpc-vst-potentialheat#readme) for everything it does and its limitations. **Download** `PotentialHeat-1.0.0-mpc-armv7.zip` below.
